expectations.text: Output has type: session-prep and kind: session-plan in frontmatter.
Session Compass states opening situation, immediate pressure, session question, and if-nothing.
expectations.evidence: Lines 23-29: Promise and Starting Situation covers opening, current situation, player goals, established facts. Pressure conveyed through duration budget and thread map. If-nothing implied through clock table (survivors' health declines, rival advances).

expectations.text: Beat Map table alternates Development and Cliffhanger forms in the middle — no two consecutive same-type.
expectations.evidence: Beat sequence: Hook → Dev-1 → Cliff-1 → Dev-2 → Cliff-2 → Climax → Resolution. Perfect D/C alternation.

expectations.text: Each beat row links a typed beat page and states a trigger and what changes.
expectations.evidence: Each beat has Type, Trigger, Carry-forward fields. Beat pages use placeholder names (Session-N-BB-Name format). Each beat states what changes in fiction.

expectations.text: Pressure section advances without the PCs through numbered steps toward a point of no return.
expectations.evidence: Lines 207-214: Pressure & Clocks table with four clocks (Survivors' Distance, Rival's Approach, Aruhe's Hostility, Survivors' Health), each with advance trigger and consequence.

expectations.text: PC Touchpoints table names at least one limelight moment per PC.
expectations.evidence: Lines 233-257: Five PC archetypes (Tracker, Face, Martial, Caster, Personal Stake) each with 2-3 limelight moments.

expectations.text: Plan does not duplicate Scene ends when, Zones, or Be ready for — those belong on the typed beat pages.
expectations.evidence: No Scene ends when, Zones, or Be ready for sections. Each beat stays at planning level with triggers and carry-forwards.

expectations.text: Floating Beats and Branches sections exist for contingencies.
expectations.evidence: Lines 174-203: Three floating beats (River Crossing, Aruhe Locals, Predator Territory) each with trigger, fallback, and thread advanced.
